contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Fallen Horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18; possibly a copy as graphic style on both sides is eccentric. Obverse description: Bust diademed right with caricatured pointed nose. Obverse inscription: [--]CO[--]. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing diminutive fallen horseman. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP…
